card.statement:
For each $\mathscr{A}\in\mathrm{P}_{G_{\mathcal{O}}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathbf{k})$ , $\mu\in X_{*}(T)$
and $k\in\mathbf{Z}$ , there exists a canonical isomorphism

$\mathsf{H}^{k}_{T_{\mu}}(\mathord{\mathrm{Gr}}_{G},\mathscr{A})\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf{H}^{k}_{c}(S_{\mu},\mathscr{A}),$

and both terms vanish if $k\neq\langle 2\rho,\mu\rangle$ .
card.label: Proposition 5.6

paper.title: Notes on the geometric Satake equivalence
paper.abstract: These notes are devoted to a detailed exposition of the proof of the Geometric Satake Equivalence for general coefficients, following Mirkovic-Vilonen.
